On 15 September 2024, members of the Dalit community joined by ASP and BSP leaders staged a protest at the Akbarpur Bahrampur police station area in Ghaziabad city (Uttar Pradesh) against the theft of a board - which had the name of Dr. B. R. Ambedkar (a Dalit champion).

On 15 September 2024, local people and family members (likely from the Dalit community since the deceased was a Dalit) of the deceased staged a protest, holding placards, along the state highway in front of a police station near Sisava Kala village (Kheri, Uttar Pradesh) demanding action against the police whom the protesters accused of assaulting a Dalit boy (detainee) - who later died at a hospital.

On 15 September 2024, unemployed Elementary Teacher Training (ETT) teachers staged a protest near the Chief Minister's (CM) residence along the Sangrur-Patiala Road in Sangrur city (Punjab) against the failure of the state government to issue the list of 2,994 backlog ETT unemployed teachers. The protesters scuffled (likely non-violent based on lack of injuries) with the police who prevented them from reaching the CM's residence.

On 15 September 2024, local people from Delhi's rural areas (360 villages), led by the head of Palam 360 (a group of villages), gathered for a mahapanchayat (large meeting) and staged a protest at Jantar Mantar in the Delhi - Connaught Place area (New Delhi, Delhi) over various demands including the development of smart villages, land pooling policy amendments, allocation of alternative plots of land in place of land acquired by the government, and tax exemptions.

On 15 September 2024, students staged a protest at Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University in the Delhi - Najafgarh area (South West Delhi, Delhi) demanding an investigation into the suicide of a student at the university hostel. The university administration removed the hostel warden.

On 15 September 2024, local people staged a prayer meeting at Ambika Florence Park and a 'shok' (mourning) protest march, carrying banners and placards, to Clockton Market at the New Chandigarh area near Mohali city (SAS Nagar, Punjab) against the Greater Mohali Area Development Authority (GMADA) for the accidents and deaths along the PR-6 Road due to the poor quality of the road.

On 15 September 2024, farmers under the banner of SKM (Non-political) gathered for a mahapanchayat (large meeting) and staged a protest at the New Grain Market in Uchana town (Jind, Haryana) over the non-fulfilment of their long-standing demands including the provision of a Minimum Support Price (MSP) for crops.

On 15 September 2024, members of the Hindu community staged a protest, raising slogans, at the Jogi Nawada area in Bareilly city (Uttar Pradesh) against the Eid Miladunnabi Anjuman procession (Islamic religious occasion) being taken out in the area - claiming that the procession should be disallowed since the Kanwar yatra (Hindu religious procession) was also disallowed in the area. The people taking out the Anjuman procession staged a counter-protest.

On 15 September 2024, family members of the deceased and nursing staff staged a sit-in protest near the Institute Of Medical Sciences at Banaras Hindu University in Varanasi city (Uttar Pradesh) against the death of a woman (nursing staff) which the protesters claimed was caused by the hospital's negligence.

On 15 September 2024, local people staged a protest and placed planks and other items along the Hathras Road at the Sasni Gate Crossing in Aligarh city (Uttar Pradesh) against the lack of consistent drinking water supply in the area for over 2 weeks.

On 15 September 2024, members of the Delhi Meitei Coordinating Committee (DMCC), Global Manipur Federation (GMF), Coordinating Committee on Manipur Integrity (COCOMI), and Meitei Alliance staged a protest at Jantar Mantar in the Delhi - Connaught Place area (New Delhi, Delhi) demanding the Prime Minister of India intervene in the ongoing communal violence in the state of Manipur. The protesters condemned the use of long-range guns and drone strikes at a village in Manipur.

On 15 September 2024, hundreds of farmers (from Varanasi, Jaunpur, and other places) staged a protest march, raising slogans, along the Varanasi-Azamgarh Road, from Danganj market to the toll plaza in Balramganj Dherahi village (Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh) demanding the removal of toll fees - claiming that roads in the area have not been developed.

On 15 September 2024, supporters of an independent politician (former BJP) staged a protest and raised slogans in Narnaul city (Mahendragarh, Haryana) against the Chief Minister (BJP) who had arrived in the city to persuade the former BJP leader to withdraw her nomination as an independent candidate for the assembly elections.

On 15 September 2024, local people staged a protest at the Gulmohar Extension area in Dera Bassi city (SAS Nagar, Punjab) over various issues including power outages, and lack of proper drainage in the area.

On 15 September 2024, unidentified assailants (likely Hindu based on the context) pelted stones at the Masjidul Huda Juma Masjid in Katipalla town (Dakshina Kannada, Karnataka) for unknown reasons. The assailants came on two bikes, pelted stones and fled.

On 15 September 2024, members of the INC staged a protest in Curchorem city (South Goa, Goa) against the bad condition of roads in the area. The protesters filled the potholes with mud and cow dung to mark their protest.

On 15 September 2024, members of the BRSV took out a protest march from the Telangana Bhavan to the Minister's Quarters in Gadwal town (Jogulamba Gadwal, Telangana) demanding the INC-led state government to repeal Government Order (GO) number 33 to ensure that local students would be given opportunities after appearing for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (Undergraduate) or NEET medical test. Police detained the protesters.

On 15 September 2024, parents along with girl students and members of the CPI staged a protest at the Mahatma Jyotiba Phule BC Welfare Residential School (Girls) in Gundlapalli village (Karimnagar, Telangana) after worms were found in the food that was served to the students. The protesters also condemned the bad condition of the toilets.

On 15 September 2024, members of the Bhagyanagar Ganesh Utsava Samithi (Hindu group) staged a protest in Hyderabad city (Telangana) demanding the Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) to allow the immersion of Ganesh idols on Tank Bund on the occasion of Ganesh Chathurthi (Hindu festival). The protesters removed flex banners and barricades set up by the GHMC and the police to mark their protest.

Around 15 September 2024 (as reported), investors of a firm called DKZ Technologies staged a protest in Hyderabad city (Telangana) after it was revealed that the firm had cheated people and taken 100 crore Indian rupees. The protesters demanded the police to catch the culprits.

On 15 September 2024, members of the BRSV staged a protest and attempted to 'lay siege' to the ministers' quarters in Hyderabad city (Telangana) demanding the INC-led state government to repeal Government Order (GO) number 33 to ensure that local students would be given opportunities after appearing for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (Undergraduate) or NEET medical test. Protesters scuffled with the police and a few protesters were detained.

On 15 September 2024, workers affiliated to the Hydel Tourism Workers Association and the CITU staged a protest at the Kerala Hydel Tourism Centre (KHTC) in Munnar town (Idukki, Kerala) demanding the LDF-led state government to give a month's salary as bonus for Onam (Kerala's harvest festival).

On 15 September 2024, residents along with members of the Catholic Sabha staged a protest by standing in the Nethravati river in Pavoor Uliya island (Dakshina Kannada, Karnataka) demanding the district administration to take measures to control the illegal sand extraction near the island. The protesters raised slogans to mark their protest.

On 15 September 2024, residents along with a ward councillor staged a protest in the Patto-Ribandar locality in Ribandar town (North Goa, Goa) against the bad condition of the roads in the locality due to the ongoing Smart City project work. The protesters demanded the government to repair the roads.

On 15 September 2024, members of the Mullaperiyar Protection Council along with members of the Kerala Catholic Bishops Council, the Church of South India (CSI) (Protestant Christian group), Kerala Vyapari Vyavasai Ekopana Samiti (KVVES) (labor group), an Infam Agricultural member and others staged a protest by organising a fast in Upputhara village (Idukki, Kerala) demanding the authorities to complete a comprehensive safety audit of the Mullaperiyar dam.

On 15 September 2024, members of the BJP including an MP and an MLA staged a protest in at a police check post on the Utnoor-Jainoor road in Utnoor town (Adilabad, Telangana) after the police stopped them when they were on their way to meet a tribal woman who had survived a rape and murder attempt in Jainoor town. The protesters were lathi (baton) charged and detained by the police.

On 15 September 2024, members of the INC including an MP staged a protest by organising a fast in Vandiperiyar town (Idukki, Kerala) demanding the authorities to complete a comprehensive safety audit of the Mullaperiyar dam and to decommission the dam.

On 15 September 2024, members of the CPI(M) and the Visakha Ukku Parirakshana Porata Committee (Visakha Steel Conservation Struggle Committee) staged a protest at the Gajuwaka Junction in Visakhapatnam city (Andhra Pradesh) against the NDA-led Union and state government's proposal to privatise the Visakhapatnam Steel Plant (VSP). The protesters raised slogans to mark their protest.

On 15 September 2024, Dalit leaders and members of progressive organisations staged a protest during a programme to inaugurate the human chain to mark International Day of Democracy on the Deputy Commissioner's Office premises in Yadgir city (Karnataka) against an INC MLA for attending the event. The protesters questioned why the INC leader was there when he was named as an accused in a case where a Dalit sub-inspector of police had died by suicide due to the harassment he faced from the MLA. The protesters shouted slogans to mark their protest.
On 15 September 2024, members of the Hindu community held a protest in Jahazpur town (Bhilwara, Rajasthan) after unidentified persons threw stones at a Hindu religious procession (coded separately).

On 15 September 2024, members of the Hindu community surrounded the police station in Sanganer town (Bhilwara, Rajasthan) demanding quick action in the stone-throwing incident in a Ganesh (Hindu deity) temple (coded separately).

On 15 September 2024, Manipuri Elders Consortium Shillong (MECS), students and persons from Meitei community staged a sit in protest in Shillong city (East Khasi Hills, Manipur) against the recent drone attacks by armed Kuki assailants (coded separately) amidst ongoing violence between Meitei and Tribal communities in the state.

On 15 September 2024, Meira Paibi activists from Yairipok Laimanai, Top-Chingtha, Yambem, Nungaipokpi, Huikap, Angtha and Poiroukhongjin staged a mass protest rally from their respective areas with slogans till Traffic Island at Yairipok market in Yairipok town (Thoubal, Manipur) against the attacks by armed Kuki assailants, inaction by the government and perceived bias towards the Kuki community by security forces amidst ongoing violence between Meitei and Tribal communities in the state.

On 15 September 2024, Meira Paibi activists from Yairipok Laimanai, Top-Chingtha, Yambem, Nungaipokpi, Huikap, Angtha and Poiroukhongjin staged a sit in protest at Lamanai Multipurpose Community Hall in Yairipok town (Thoubal, Manipur) against the attacks by armed Kuki assailants, inaction by the government and perceived bias towards the Kuki community by security forces amidst ongoing violence between Meitei and Tribal communities in the state.

On 15 September 2024, members of Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) held a protest march towards the Raj Bhavan in Patna city (Bihar) over the claimed deteriorating law and order situation in the state and requested the intervention of the Governor.

On 15 September 2024, students of Cotton State University staged a road block protest in Guwahati city (Kamrup Metropolitan, Assam) after a man was hit by a speeding water tanker in front of Mahendra Nath Deka Phukan Hostel and demanded authorities to take actions to prevent similar accidents.

On 15 September 2024, hundreds of junior students of Agricultural University gathered, chanted slogans, and held a sit-in protest outside the Adhartal police station in Jabalpur city (Madhya Pradesh), demanding action against the accused involved in misbehaving with female students during Ganesh (Hindu deity) idol immersion celebrations.

The victim was immolated alive by the villagers. The villagers also threw stones at the police when they went to rescue them leaving some policemen injured. Three family members of the victim who were also injured, were rescued by the police.

On 15 September 2024, around 150 villagers and residents from Phursungi and Uruli Devachi blocked the road in the Pune district (coded to Pune city, Maharashtra), during a protest against the state government's decision to turn the two villages into a municipal council.
On 15 September 2024, a group of people assaulted and killed three women and two men at Ektal village under Konta police station (Sukma, Chhattisgarh) over claimed engagement in practicing sorcery.

The protesters engaged in a scuffle (likely non-violent due to lack of injuries) with the BJP leaders' supporters whom they accused of breaking the phones of local people who were taking videos.

On 27 September 2024, the members of the Muslim community held a rally, staged a road blockade by burning tires on the road, ransacked the vehicle of the Bhadrak tahsildar (revenue officer), and threw stones at the police and other officials at Santhia area of Bhadrak town (Bhadrak, Odisha) during a demonstration demanding immediate arrest of the persons behind an objectionable social media post. As many as three police officials including the Bhadrak city DSP were injured. The police officials used mild baton charges to control the mob. As many as 10 platoons of the police force and three Inspector in charge (IIC)s were deployed at the spot to check for any further escalation.

On 27 September 2024, JKNC and INC members held a joint protest march at Bandipora town (J&K) against the detention of youth leaders and members amidst the ongoing state assembly elections and demanded free and fair election process.

On 27 September 2024, local people staged a protest along the Kachhwa-Kapsethi Road in Chhateri Manapur village (Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh) demanding compensation for family members of the deceased who were hit and killed by a speeding car.

The protesters also condemned the detention of a Hindu religious leader.

The protesters did not allow the police to shift the body for post-mortem to mark their protest.

On 27 September 2024, locals along with a BJP MP staged protests in the Kothapeta and Chaitanyapuri areas in Hyderabad city (Telangana) against government officials for conducting a survey to mark houses that were suspectedly built on encroached land along the Musi river. A protester attempted to die by suicide by pouring petrol on himself and was stopped by the authorities.

Around 27 September 2024 (as reported), members of student unions staged protests at the Sri Chaitanya Akshara College in the Madapur locality in Hyderabad city (Telangana) after over 100 students fell ill after consuming contaminated food. The protesters demanded action against the management.

On 27 September 2024, a large number of SFI members staged a 'Vidyarthi Mahagarjana' (student) protest at the Dharna Chowk in Hyderabad city (Telangana) demanding the INC-led state government to appoint an Education Minister, resolve fee reimbursement issues, construct permanent buildings for the welfare residential schools and colleges and appoint vice chancellors to state universities. Protesters attempted to march to the Secretariat and were arrested by the police.
On 27 September 2024, farmers staged a protest 'Day 2' and locked the market committee office in Kaithal city (Haryana) against the non-procurement of paddy crops.

On 27 September 2024, around 20 people assaulted nurses and junior doctors at a hospital in Kamarhati town (North 24 Parganas district, WB) over the death of patient undergoing treatment at the hospital. Following the incident the doctors announced a strike.
